title: 光合作用与细胞呼吸
lead: 同一对物质，两个方向：一个把光存起来，一个把存的取出来花。
leadEn: One pair of substances, two directions: one banks the light, the other spends the savings.
west: 光合作用：叶绿体用光能把二氧化碳和水造成有机物、放出氧气——把光能存成化学能，只在含色素的细胞里开工。
westEn: Photosynthesis: chloroplasts use light to build organic matter from carbon dioxide and water, releasing oxygen—light banked as chemical energy, in pigment-bearing cells only.
east: 细胞呼吸：线粒体把有机物氧化回二氧化碳和水、释放能量供细胞使用——全天不停，不分动植物。
eastEn: Respiration: mitochondria oxidize organic matter back to carbon dioxide and water, spending the energy on the cell's work—running all day, plant and animal alike.
bridge: 两条路互为逆反应却并非在同一个炉子里往返：场所、条件与中间步骤全都不同。白天光合速率压过呼吸，净放氧；夜里只剩呼吸在放二氧化碳。
bridgeEn: Reverse roads, but not the same furnace run backward: sites, conditions and every middle step differ. By day photosynthesis outruns respiration and the leaf nets out oxygen; by night only the dioxide tap stays open.

title: 有丝分裂与减数分裂
lead: 都是分染色体，一个求「一模一样」，一个求「独一无二」。
leadEn: Both sort chromosomes: one aims for identical copies, the other for unique ones.
west: 有丝分裂：复制一次、分裂一次，产出两个与母细胞染色体数相同的子细胞——生长、修复与无性繁殖的施工队。
westEn: Mitosis: copy once, divide once—two daughters with the mother's chromosome count. The construction crew for growth, repair and asexual reproduction.
east: 减数分裂：复制一次、连分两次，染色体减半，且前期同源染色体互换、后期自由组合——配子的多样性制造间。
eastEn: Meiosis: copy once, divide twice—halving the count, with crossing over in prophase and free shuffling at the split: the diversity mint for gametes.
bridge: 数字口径一对照就清楚：体细胞加倍再均分保持不变，生殖细胞加倍再分两次得半数，受精当场合回全额。遗传与变异的分工就藏在这两次「分」里。
bridgeEn: Count it and it clicks: body cells double-then-split to hold the number; germ cells double-then-split-twice to halve it, and fertilization restores the full purse. The heredity-versus-variation split hides in those two divisions.

title: DNA 与 RNA
lead: 一对核酸兄弟：一个锁在保险柜里当母本，一个到处跑腿当工头。
leadEn: Two nucleic-acid brothers: one vaulted as the master copy, one running sites as the foreman.
west: DNA：双链脱氧核酸，碱基对 A-T、C-G，藏在细胞核（与线粒体）里——长期存储的遗传母本。
westEn: DNA: the double-stranded deoxy archive, pairs A-T and C-G, vaulted in the nucleus (and mitochondria)—the long-term hereditary master copy.
east: RNA：单链核糖核酸，U 顶替 T，种类多——信使、转运、核糖体 RNA 各司其职，还兼任部分病毒的遗传物质。
eastEn: RNA: single-stranded ribonucleic working copies—messenger, transfer, ribosomal, with U for T—some viruses run on it as their heredity.
bridge: 信息从 DNA 抄到 RNA 再到蛋白质，是「中心法则」的主道；少数病毒能倒着抄，那是旁门而非主流。双链稳、单链活——存储与执行选了不同的分子材质。
bridgeEn: Information flows DNA→RNA→protein on the central highway; a few viruses reverse-transcribe along side roads. Double strands for stable storage, single strands for nimble work—different materials for different jobs.

title: 生产者与消费者
lead: 生态系统的两个编制：一个负责把无机物造成饭，一个负责吃别人造的饭。
leadEn: Two posts in the ecosystem's chart: one makes food out of the non-living, one eats what's made.
west: 生产者：自养生物——绿色植物与光合细菌、化能合成菌，把无机物固定成有机物，是能量入口。
westEn: Producers: the self-feeding—green plants, photosynthetic and chemosynthetic microbes—fixing the inorganic into organic, the gate where energy enters.
east: 消费者：异养生物——从植食动物到各级肉食动物，取食现成有机物；连同分解者一起，把固定的物质逐级流转。
eastEn: Consumers: the other-feeding—from grazers up the predator ladder—taking packaged organic matter, passing it along with the decomposers.
bridge: 边界并不绝对：捕蝇草是生产者也「吃虫」；分解者独立成第三编制。口诀按营养方式记，别按长相记——生态地位看的是碳从哪儿来。
bridgeEn: The line smudges: a sundew produces and 'eats' insects; decomposers hold their own post. Classify by how carbon is acquired, not by looks.

title: 先天性行为与学习行为
lead: 一出生就会的，和活着活着才会的——两条来路，一个神经系统。
leadEn: What arrives with you and what accretes while living—two roads, one nervous system.
west: 先天性行为：遗传定型的固定动作——蜘蛛结网、三棘鱼的红色触发攻击，不用教、错了也改不掉。
westEn: Innate acts: genetically preset routines—orb webs, a stickleback's red-triggered attack—untaught and stubbornly un-rewrong.
east: 学习行为：经验改写的行为——迷宫走快、黑猩猩叠箱取香蕉，依赖神经系统的可塑性，越高等余地越大。
eastEn: Learned acts: experience-rewritten behavior—maze times falling, chimps stacking boxes for bananas—riding neural plasticity, wider room in higher animals.
bridge: 多数行为是两者掺铸：鸣鸟的曲调框架先天、细节靠幼期学习。用「全本能或全后天」的二分吵架，在生物学里两头都站不稳。
bridgeEn: Most acts are alloys: a songbird's skeleton is born, its dialect learned young. Debates that pick 'all instinct' or 'all nurture' stand on no firm biological ground.

title: 病毒与细菌
lead: 都小得要显微镜，但一边连「细胞」的门槛都没迈进来。
leadEn: Both need microscopes—yet one never crossed the threshold into 'cell'.
west: 细菌：单细胞原核生物，有细胞结构、能独立代谢繁殖——绝大多数无害甚至有益，抗生素治的是少数致病菌。
westEn: Bacteria: single-celled prokaryotes with full cell machinery, feeding and dividing alone—the vast majority harmless or helpful; antibiotics target the disease few.
east: 病毒：蛋白质外壳包一段遗传物质，无细胞结构、不能独立代谢，必须进入宿主细胞借机器复制——是否算「生物」至今存疑。
eastEn: Viruses: genes in a protein coat—no cell, no independent metabolism, copying only by hijacking a host's machinery—their status as 'living' stays argued.
bridge: 尺寸与结构线一刀切开：细菌有核糖体、能产能，病毒什么都没有、只有一段指令。所以抗病毒药走「拦截复制」路线，与抗菌思路完全不同。
bridgeEn: A structural cut: bacteria carry ribosomes and make energy; viruses carry only instructions. Hence antivirals block copying—nothing like the antibacterial playbook.

title: 真菌与细菌
lead: 发霉和发馊不是一回事：一边有核有膜，一边什么都没有。
leadEn: Mold and spoil are not one trade: one has a nucleus and membranes, the other neither.
west: 真菌：真核生物——霉菌、酵母、蘑菇，细胞有核膜，靠分泌酶体外消化再吸收，菌丝与几丁质外骨骼是标志。
westEn: Fungi: eukaryotes—molds, yeasts, mushrooms—with nucleus and membranes; they secrete enzymes, digest outside, absorb back; hyphae and chitin walls are the signature.
east: 细菌：原核生物——无核膜，细胞壁成分与真菌不同，靠分裂繁殖；形状是球、杆、螺旋几大类。
eastEn: Bacteria: prokaryotes—no nucleus, different wall chemistry, dividing in two; spheres, rods and spirals are the wardrobe.
bridge: 演化上真菌与动物同为真核阵营，反而和细菌分家极早——酵母与人的差异比酵母与细菌小得多。抗生素错打真菌、抗真菌药错打细菌，都是把这条线忘了。
bridgeEn: In evolution, fungi are eukaryotic kin of animals, estranged from bacteria since the domain split—yeast differs less from you than from a bacterium. Antibiotics mishitting fungi (or antifungals hitting bacteria) forget this line.

title: 初生演替与次生演替
lead: 一片荒原与一场火烧过——群落重建，起跑线完全不同。
leadEn: Raw rock versus a burnt field: community rebuilds start on opposite lines.
west: 初生演替：从零开始——裸岩、火山灰、新冰碛上先遣地衣苔藓造土，千年起步，方向从无机到有机。
westEn: Primary succession: from nothing—lichens and mosses on bare rock, ash or fresh moraine manufacture soil; a millennium-scale start, from the inorganic upward.
east: 次生演替：留有遗产——火或砍伐后土壤、种子库、根系尚在，草本灌木乔木接力，几十到几百年可复林。
eastEn: Secondary succession: an estate survives—soil, seed bank and roots outlast fire or axe; herbs, shrubs and trees in relay, forest back in decades to centuries.
bridge: 分界只看一件事：土壤有没有。把弃耕农田误判成「荒地」走初生剧本，会把复绿计划慢算一个数量级——次生地上「放任」常常已是很好的恢复。
bridgeEn: One test: does soil remain? Reading an abandoned field as 'waste' and running the primary script slow-plans greening by an order of magnitude—on secondary land, simply leaving it alone is often restoration.

title: 特异性免疫与非特异性免疫
lead: 一边是不分敌我的堤坝，一边是记黑名单的特种部队。
leadEn: One a wall that treats all intruders alike; one a force that keeps a blacklist.
west: 非特异性（先天）免疫：皮肤黏膜屏障、吞噬细胞与炎症反应——生来就有、对谁都用同一套，不设专一目标。
westEn: Innate immunity: skin and mucosa barriers, macrophages, inflammation—born with it, one doctrine for all callers, no specialization.
east: 特异性（获得）免疫：B 细胞抗体与 T 细胞细胞免疫——一病原一方案，且有记忆细胞，再次遭遇快且猛，疫苗吃这条红利。
eastEn: Adaptive immunity: B-cell antibodies and T-cell attack—one pathogen, one protocol—with memory cells answering faster and harder the second time; vaccines live on this.
bridge: 并非两套系统各干各：先天免疫先顶住并「报警呈递」，特异性免疫据此精准扩容；应答完还由调节力量收尾。免疫力这个词，其实是两级防线的协同总分。
bridgeEn: Not two solo acts: the innate wall holds and hands over the evidence; the adaptive response scales precision on it, then brakes after. 'Immunity' scores the duet, not either singer.

title: 有氧呼吸与无氧呼吸
lead: 同一份葡萄糖，烧到底和烧半截——能量账差一个数量级。
leadEn: One glucose, burned to ash or to embers—the energy ledger differs by an order of magnitude.
west: 有氧呼吸：葡萄糖彻底氧化为二氧化碳和水，能量大量转入 ATP——细胞的标准火力全开。
westEn: Aerobic respiration: glucose fully oxidized to carbon dioxide and water, much energy harvested into ATP—the cell at full burn.
east: 无氧呼吸：缺氧时有机物只分解一半——动物肌肉出乳酸、酵母出酒精，产能寥寥，救急不救穷。
eastEn: Anaerobic: with oxygen short, the fuel only cracks—lactate in muscle, alcohol and gas in yeast—meager yield, a bridge not a bank.
bridge: 无氧不是有氧的开关旋钮，而是另一条化学路径；长跑后肌肉的酸胀与面团发起来，是同一步「半烧」在两个界的两张发票。发酵本质就是微生物的无氧呼吸。
bridgeEn: Anaerobic is a different chemical road, not a dial off the aerobic one. Post-race soreness and a rising dough are two receipts from the same half-burn, one in animals, one in microbes—fermentation is microbial anaerobic respiration.

title: 显性与隐性
lead: 杂合时露面的叫显性，藏一世的叫隐性——强弱是表象，剂量才是机制。
leadEn: The trait showing in a heterozygote is dominant, the one hiding is recessive—looks say strong/weak; dose says the mechanism.
west: 显性：杂合状态下就能表现——往往一个等位基因产出的蛋白剂量已够用，功能型常显。
westEn: Dominant: expressed even in heterozygotes—one working allele's protein dose often suffices; functional types are commonly dominant.
east: 隐性：纯合才露面——两个拷贝都失功，表型才兜不住；白化等代谢缺陷多为隐性路线。
eastEn: Recessive: only visible when both copies fail—the phenotype has nothing left to mask it; many metabolic defects run recessive.
bridge: 显隐性说的是「表型对剂量的响应」，不是等位基因的能量等级——近亲婚配抬高隐性纯合概率，正是「藏得住」的代价，而隐性从不是「弱」。
bridgeEn: Dominance describes the phenotype's dose response, not gene strength. Consanguinity raising recessive-homozygote odds is the price of 'hideable'—never of 'weaker'.

title: 遗传与变异
lead: 一个负责复制不走样，一个负责复制必走样——进化是两股的合伙生意。
leadEn: One keeps copies faithful, one keeps them flawed—evolution is their joint venture.
west: 遗传：DNA 复制与中心法则把性状蓝图代代传下——种瓜得瓜，稳定性是物种存在的前提。
westEn: Heredity: DNA copying and the central dogma hand the blueprint down—melons from melon seeds; stability is the precondition for any species.
east: 变异：复制差错、重组与环境诱变给每代掺新——多数中性或有害，偶有可用，自然选择只认这一份新料。
eastEn: Variation: copy slips, recombination and mutagens spike each generation—mostly neutral or harmful, occasionally useful, and selection trades only in that novelty.
bridge: 没有遗传，有利变异留不住；没有变异，遗传只是一潭死水。抗药菌与收割机的军备竞赛，正是两条同时在线的账单。
bridgeEn: Without heredity, useful variants leak away; without variation, heredity is a stagnant pond. The arms race of resistant bacteria and our counters is the ledger of both lines running.
